description: "Soffrona and Her Cat Muff" by Mary Martha Sherwood is a children's story written in the early 19th century. This charming tale follows the adventures of a young girl named Soffrona and her beloved cat, Muff, exploring themes of kindness, responsibility, and the innocence of childhood.
